title: Live queue follow-ups from the #746 final review: Retry note, chunk error boundary, fallback, preload
acceptance: A Retry whose read is superseded by a candidate-set change does not leave the sr-only status line on "Checking readiness for <class>…": the note clears or reports the newer read's outcome.
A Live chunk that still fails to load after lazyWithReload's reload shows a Live-scoped recovery state, not the app-level error screen.
The Live Suspense fallback keeps the Live heading and layout, so the first open does not shift content.
The Live chunk is preloaded after first paint (idle), so the first Live open does not wait on a fetch.
LiveWorkspace's per-class read tokens are pruned with the candidate set.
